about: Hand-kept (spec #1, module 7, and GLOSSARY.md, 'Alias file'). Lists each Legislator Code that has no Legislators row in the feed and says who it is. A code that has a row never needs a 'person' entry: the row wins. Every entry cites its evidence from the feed itself, as entity set, row and what the row says; never from memory or the web. If the feed gives no evidence for a code, do not map it: the code stays unresolved and the ingest worker's report lists it. An entry says one of two things. 'same_person_as' names another Legislator Code of the same Session that has a Legislators row, for a person whose code changed (for example by changing chamber). It joins the two codes into one Legislator even if the feed lists a row for both, and the Legislator's id is the one this entry's code makes, so the id is the same in a snapshot that has only the old code, only the new one, or both. Two entries cannot name the same code, and an entry cannot name a code that has an entry of its own. 'person' names a person the Legislators rows do not list at all. Entries are per Session, because a code can name a different person in another Session. Evidence marked 'cache' is a row of the cached 2025R1 feed (.cache/olis-2025R1/feed/, not committed); 'fixture' is a row of test/fixtures/olis-2025R1/feed/. The evidence for the entries now in the file was read from the cache (pulled 2026-10-28) on 2026-10-30, Pacific.
